mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1

SELECT u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.nickname,''),'社区用户') nickname, COALESCE(p.avatar_url,'') avatar_url, COALESCE(p.bio,'') bio FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1
SELECT b.*,u.id linked_id FROM community_blogger b LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.id = b.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.enabled = 1

SELECT b.user_id FROM cms_news n JOIN community_blogger b ON b.id = n.blogger_id JOIN user_account u ON u.id = b.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 WHERE n.id = #{newsId} AND n.is_deleted = 0
SELECT blogger_id FROM cms_news WHERE id = #{newsId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 AND u.id<>#{viewer} AND LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(p.nickname,''))>0

SELECT u.id FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.account_status = 1 AND u.id<>#{viewer} AND LOCATE(#{keyword},COALESCE(p.nickname,''))>0 ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
